id: title:EDsCODE:keep raw mode when opening managed queries

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that when navigating to an existing warehouse URL with a HogQL query and no explicit `sendRawQuery` parameter, the editor correctly re-applies its default behavior (sending raw queries) rather than retaining previous state.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks SQL Editor initialization and mode enforcement for warehouse connections; relevant to warehouse users and dashboard reliability.

observations.behavior: Adds a call to enforce raw query mode immediately before focusing the editor, ensuring the desired execution mode is applied regardless of whether the underlying connection object was reused or replaced.
observations.posthog_connection: Reinforces warehouse-specific workflow correctness in the frontend; could prevent silent failures if warehouse settings are lost during navigation.
